items.title: AMD Stock Looks Poised to Revisit Its All-Time Highs
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices’ (AMD) stock looks poised to revisit its all-time highs. The market has already bought into its growth story. Now, the next opportunity may lie in how much of that growth turns into profits. After a triple-digit gain in 2026, the stock has pulled back from its October record highs, but the fundamentals help explain much of that rally. items.summary: Investing.com -- Meta Platforms is testing an internal prediction-market app called Takes, allowing employees to predict the outcomes of events using virtual points rather than real money, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
